answer_1.quote: We propose an efficient mind-map generation network (EMGN) to address the above issues... The proposed method encodes all sentences sequentially and generates the graph via sequence-to-graph.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the generated mind-map by comparing the tree similarity with the human-annotated mind-map... The ROUGE score between the sampled decisions and the highlights A is used to define the reward.

answer_4.quote: Two experts manually annotate the ground-truth mind-maps for these articles. If one of the experts disagrees with any content of the mind-map, they discuss to reach consensus.
answer_4.guideline: The manual highlights written by the editors summarize the key ideas of a document.
